edits.why: line 14 is the colophon 'Записано от чукчи Кытэӄына весной 1897 г. на урочищѣ Сухарномъ', a one-line attribution set off in a gap on both sides, not a paragraph start; MainZone-Other covers what the other types do not (headings, captions).

notes.text: Line 1 is absent from every band and from the composite; the running-title band lists lines 0 and 1, so the head's text layer may be split across two rows.
